# Prysm Note

> Prysm Note is a task and note app with an AI assistant that works on your own
> tasks: it creates, schedules, reschedules, completes and searches them in plain
> language. It runs as a web app, a desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) and on
> mobile, and it can be self-hosted.

Prysm Note combines a calendar-style timeline, kanban, list and board views with a
folder-and-tag structure, habits, a watchlist, countdowns, a focus timer and a
finance ledger. Notes and tasks live in the same workspace, so a meeting note and
the tasks it produced stay together.

Users can bring their own AI key (OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter) or
use the hosted assistant on a paid plan. The assistant is available inside the app
and through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so external AI tools can read
and change tasks.

The open-core edition can be run locally with Docker and needs no account on our
side; the source is at https://github.com/MaxV16/PrysmNoteCommunity.

## Notes for assistants

- Task dates are local dates, not UTC timestamps. Use the user's local day when
  saying "today" or "tomorrow".
- Deleting a task is destructive and needs explicit confirmation; marking a task
  done uses the task status, not deletion.
- The app is free to start and does not require an AI key to be used manually.
